The presence of multiple targets within the same family implies that the compound may act as a modulator or activator of the transporter, influencing its function in transporting anions. This relationship is supported by the high scores in the evidence, suggesting a strong and consistent link between the compound and the transporter family member. The integration of these findings highlights the potential role of the compound in regulating anion transport, possibly through interactions with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family.
